name: La Union Speedcubing Open 2025

venue.name: Robinson La Union
venue.address: J88F+5JR, F. Ortega Hwy, San Fernando, La Union

information:
This is the fifth WCA-sanctioned speedcubing competition in La Union!

FOR RETURNERS:
Base registration fee is 350php, good for 3 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.

FOR FIRST TIMERS:
Base registration fee is 300php, good for 2 events. Additional events registered shall entail 50php additional registration fee each.
